description:
Pay {0} to activate Outrider en-Kor, targeting Daru Spiritualist.
Daru Spiritualist triggers, giving itself +0/+2 untill end of turn.
Repeat steps 1-2 untill Daru Spiritualist has infinite toughness.
Pay {W} to cast Worthy Cause, sacrificing Daru Spiritualist and gaining life equal to its toughness.
